newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light to defer Black Point units.
newsitem.headline: China Light to defer Black Point units.

text.p: China Light & Power Co Ltd has agreed to defer generating units seven and eight at its Black Point power plant in Hong Kong for up to five years if the situation requires, the government said on Monday.
But the government would review the situation with the company in 1999 based on the demand forecast at the time, Secretary for Economic Services Stephen Ip said in a statement.
China Light said earlier that the deferral of units seven and eight could cost the company between HK$200 million and HK$1.5 billion in additional costs.
